subject: Re: Alignment call for AtlasHealth pilot — need to move
messages:
From: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@atlashealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Kim <laura.kim@atlashealth.com>, AtlasHealth Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot walkthrough — Thu Aug 20?

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the pilot materials. Our team is keen to see the end-to-end demo and align on integration points. Would Thu, Aug 20 at 10:00 AM PT work for a 60-minute run-through? I can get the following folks on the call: Laura (product), our procurement lead, and one of our infra folks.

If that slot is tight for you, happy to move — we want the right people there so we can walk through data boundary questions and contractual next steps.

Best,
Ethan
Ethan Brooks
Director, Platform Partnerships
AtlasHealth
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot walkthrough — Thu Aug 20?

Hi Ethan — great to hear. Quick heads-up: our security and platform leads have asked to join this session (Vivek will be the security SME) and procurement wants to cover a brief commercial alignment during the call. Given that, we should expand to 90 minutes so we have time for a tech deep dive plus procurement Q&A. Rafael and Tessa are looped to help coordinate.

Can you confirm whether procurement needs legal on the call, and whether the procurement lead you mentioned will be remote on the 20th? Procurement mentioned travel windows on their side yesterday, so there may be a conflict.

If Aug 20 doesn't work with the expanded attendee list, here are three alternate windows (all PT):
- Mon Aug 23 — 11:00–12:30
- Tue Aug 24 — 13:00–14:30
- Wed Aug 25 — 14:00–15:30

I attached an updated agenda (proposed_agenda_v2.pdf) with timing suggestions. If you prefer, we can split into a 30–45 min exec summary for your leadership and a separate 60–75 min technical session for platform/security/procurement.

Thanks — I want to make sure we have the right SMEs and time to answer data governance and network questions.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@atlashealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Kim <laura.kim@atlashealth.com>, AtlasHealth Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot walkthrough — Thu Aug 20?

Thanks Mina — appreciate the updated agenda. Quick note from procurement: several folks will be traveling Aug 20–22 for a vendor commitment and won't be available those days. They asked whether we could aim for Aug 24 or Aug 25 instead.

Also, a heads-up from our execs: they'd like an optional 30–45 minute executive summary that hits risk, runbook, and pricing bullets before the deep dive. If you can supply both (exec summary + full session), that would be ideal.

Would Aug 24 (13:00 PT) or Aug 25 (14:00 PT) work with your team and the added security/platform attendees? If you can do the exec summary earlier the same day (or the afternoon before), we can try to keep leadership engaged without taking the whole team twice.

Best,
Ethan
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Pilot walkthrough — scheduling check (internal coordination)

Internal note — quick availability check from our side: Vivek can do Wed Aug 25 after 13:00 PT; Tessa and I are flexible on Aug 24 and Aug 25 afternoons. Suggest we confirm Aug 25, 14:00–15:30 PT for the full session (90m) and offer a 30–45m exec summary at 13:00 PT the same day if AtlasHealth wants it.

Sharing our mutual action plan link so we can keep owners/timeboxes in one place: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExampleSharedAgenda

If Mina is OK, I'll send a calendar hold to AtlasHealth now with both slots (exec summary + full session) and mark procurement as tentative until they confirm travel.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Laura Kim <laura.kim@atlashealth.com>, AtlasHealth Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Wed Aug 25 — Exec summary + full session (updated materials attached)

Ethan / team — thanks for the quick replies and for flagging procurement travel. Confirming the following:

- Exec summary (optional): Wed Aug 25, 13:00–13:30 PT — 30 minutes, covers risk, runbook, and pricing highlights.
- Full session (recommended for platform/security/procurement): Wed Aug 25, 14:00–15:30 PT — 90 minutes.

I've attached the mutual action plan (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx) with owners and a finalized agenda. Please let us know who will attend each segment (exec vs. full session) so we can tailor slides. Calendar invites are live here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-atlas-redwood

If procurement confirms they can't join live, we'll record and share the recording plus a short procurement-only addendum addressing contract timeline and SSO/KMS questions.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Warmly,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (spreadsheet — owners & timeline)
